Thank you so much for the compliments, I'm glad you like it. Whenever I make a site, I'm never sure what most people think of it, unless I've done a big case study or something on it, that is. Your site looks good, and it's a great look for an Apple-related site. I really like the top semi-transparent black bar, and I love how thin it is; it adds elegance to the site, but without distracting from it. As a professional web designer/developer, I love talking with others about design, so forgive me if I come off as too opinionated, or harsh, because I really only mean it as a compliment, but I do have some questions and feedback about your site (aside from it being about Apple stuff; ANDROID4LYFE!). Almost all of what I'm going to say is completely subjective and purely opinion, but... the header could be shorter in height, though I know Apple loves big header sections, so that may fit well with your target audience. You could use "background-size: cover" to make that gray background span the entire width of the screen. I have an ultra-wide monitor, so there's lots of white space on either side of it, right now. Additionally, a major rule for modern web design is "white space is king, most of the time." White space is fantastic when it's applied vertically, but horizontally it is far more conditional. Add some extra spacing between the lines of text in your paragraph, and above the "HOME" title and below the paragraph. Then, make sure the spacing above "HOME" and below the paragraph are the same. Symmetry is always good. As far as the rest of the site goes, it's fairly plain. Try using some colors; I know Apple loves using pastels and bright accents, so try some of those. The side bar is an entire monster that I typically avoid unless it's on mobile, but that's a personal thing. For instance, the search box doesn't really stand out, and I clicked the button thinking it was the form field (the search box doesn't look much different from a heading, or a link). The text for the search field is black, too, which means I can't see what I'm typing. Also, the button to open the menu is kinda hidden. I just happened to notice a tiny white line in the top right corner, and clicked on it; I never would have guessed the site even had a navigation menu. Is that really needed for a site that has 3 pages? Kinda on the same point: what does the search feature search, exactly?

That being said, I love the simplicity of it, and it's easy to get around, even without knowing there was a sidebar. How did you come up with the idea to have the typing header? That's a really cool feature. I think you have a great design started, and I'd love to see it fleshed out a bit more. I love seeing what others come up with, and that's where I get some amazing ideas, like the header on my site. I'm actually going to be changing the mobile nav, because I think there's a much better way to do it with so few links, but web design is a constantly evolving medium, and it's exciting to be part of it. Your site already looks great; it just needs a couple of tweaks to be really really good. Great work!
